# Implement failure handling workflows & alerting mechanisms (`playbook-development-8`)

Agent provides a production-grade, platform-agnostic logging framework designed to standardize telemetry across Databricks, Fabric, Synapse, and ADF. It delivers the IngestionLogger class, which serializes notebook metadata into structured JSON strings for automatic capture by Azure Monitor and Log Analytics. By abstracting the logging lifecycle into start(), end_success(), and end_failure() methods, this utility ensures high developer experience (DX) while protecting Spark performance through optimized row-counting logic and native exception re-raising.
